answer: Give every identity its own task. Each epoch the beacon derives a unique prompt from each account key, with different required words, topic and length limit. An answer can't be reused across puppets, and any reply more than 80% similar to another account's scores zero. A 1,000-puppet farm must write 1,000 distinct answers, about 1,000 separate model runs, so it costs as much as 1,000 honest agents. Like a wharf where each boat has its own numbered berth, one reply's echo fits no other slot, and the cost ridge between real work and copying stays steep.
